candidates.counter_evidence_explanation: Gateway metrics/logs are healthy, consistent with errors originating in order, not gateway.
missing_evidence: Order error stack traces or exception types to identify the failing code path
candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 unhandled request failures (10 occurrences) with error_rate 0.24 and p95 520ms, propagating ERROR spans to gateway checkout calls (1917ms).
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause of the 500s (code defect vs dependency) is not established.

report.explanation: Order service shows elevated error rate, 500 logs, and ERROR spans propagating to gateway, while gateway itself is healthy. Deployment record alone does not establish causation. Underlying defect behind the 500s remains unidentified.
